ray_half_width_deg.description: wedge half-width for each cardinal ray's median (converted to radians at point of use)

closing_tolerance_m.description: how far forward+back may fall short of the mat before a reading is rejected

retry_window_s.description: how long after the direction commit a refused measurement keeps being retried

retry_align_tolerance_deg.description: how far off the start corridor's bearing a retried measurement is still believed
